details: CONFIRMED by reading. The item's Why names the cause: "the rule 'no command over 4 minutes' invites timeout". That rule is roles/parts/limits.md, assembled into 9 agent files; the change patched one of them (runner.md, by hand outside the markers) and left the source. Principle 6 (cause, not symptom) and the brief ("Fix at the cause") point at the shared part. The change's own text in SKILL.md ("so no agent calls it") is the promise not kept, which makes the fix inside. Size: 10 agent minutes (one line in limits.md, bin/relay sync agents, move the test to assert on all Limits carriers, drop the runner duplicate).
evidence: $ grep -l "relay:part limits" plugins/*/agents/*.md   -> 9 files (checker, critic, thinker, spec-reviewer, fixer, worker, author, spec-conformance, runner)
$ grep -rl "macOS has no" plugins/*/agents/*.md roles  -> plugins/delegate/agents/runner.md only
$ command -v timeout; echo $?  -> 1 (no timeout on this Mac)
failing_case: A delegate:worker or delegate:fixer brief says "loop on <a test suite that takes 6 minutes>". The worker reads its Limits ("No command blocks longer than 4 minutes; no Bash `timeout` above 240000 ms"), has no line saying macOS lacks the `timeout` program, and wraps the run as `timeout 600 pytest ...`: exit 127 on macOS. Now: only plugins/delegate/agents/runner.md has "macOS has no `timeout` program"; SKILL.md:160-162 says "macOS has no `timeout` program, so no agent calls it". Should: every agent that carries the Limits part gets the line, from the one shared source.
fix_hint: Put "macOS has no `timeout` program (exit 127): never wrap a command in it; bound a job with the recipe below." into roles/parts/limits.md right after its first line, run bin/relay sync agents, and delete the hand-written "Bounding a long job on macOS" section from runner.md (Limits sits right below it). Extend the test to every agent file with a limits part.

2. roles/parts/limits.md holds the line once; the relay_roles check (agents match their parts) stays green.
3. runner.md still has the nohup + kill -0 recipe under Limits (tests/test_agents.py test_timeout_recipe_is_named_and_runs_on_macos still passes).
4. SKILL.md's claim and the agent texts agree: either all agents are told, or the skill says only "the runner".
